title: C++: Min Heap
description: Implement a min-heap with insert and extract-min.

steps.title: Min Heap
steps.description: Create a MinHeap class with vector<int> data. Implement void push(int val) and int pop(). Test by inserting 5,3,8,1,9,2 and extracting all (should print 1 2 3 5 8 9).
hints: push: add at end, bubble up (parent: (i-1)/2).
pop: swap root with last, remove last, bubble down (children: 2*i+1, 2*i+2).
